scope:
Exact production audio HoverHandler; offscreen Qt input/timer regression.

The supplied MainCtx/FSM boundaries count activity and arm a real Qt timer.
This does not establish native VLC playback or Windows input acceptance.

checks.name: Exact production hover block loads with the supplied boundary
Actual Qt pointer movement reveals once
Point notification is a real Qt signal
Unchanged point notification cannot restart the timer
Stationary notification churn cannot prevent real idle expiry
Changed scene position still reveals controls
Leaving and reentering at the same position reveals again
